businessGoals.name: Hassle-free Returns
businessGoals.description: Process customer returns efficiently with refunds

domainConcepts.name: Return Request
domainConcepts.description: A customer's request to return purchased items

domainConcepts.name: Refund
domainConcepts.description: Money returned to the customer after a successful return

rules.description: Only paid orders can be returned
An approved return cannot be modified
Refund amount equals the order total
A return request must reference an existing order

modules.name: Returns
modules.description: Handles customer return requests within the sales context

modules.name: ReturnProcessing
modules.description: Handles physical return of goods in the fulfillment context

buildingBlocks.name: ReturnRequest
buildingBlocks.description: Aggregate root for a customer return request

behaviours.name: submit
behaviours.description: Creates a new return request for a paid order

behaviours.name: approve
behaviours.description: Approves the return request, initiating refund

buildingBlocks.name: ReturnRequestId
buildingBlocks.description: Unique identifier for a return request

buildingBlocks.name: ReturnRequested
buildingBlocks.description: Emitted when a return request is submitted

buildingBlocks.name: ReturnReceipt
buildingBlocks.description: Tracks the physical receipt of returned goods at the warehouse

behaviours.name: receive
behaviours.description: Records that returned goods have been received

behaviours.name: inspect
behaviours.description: Marks the returned goods as inspected

buildingBlocks.name: ReturnReceiptId
buildingBlocks.description: Unique identifier for a return receipt

buildingBlocks.name: ReturnReceived
buildingBlocks.description: Emitted when returned goods are received at the warehouse

useCases.name: Submit Return
useCases.description: Customer submits a return request for a paid order
